1.1.2.en: Fixed a timer display bug. Additional capabilities for monitoring.
1.1.2.nl: Een timer weergave bug opgelost. Aanvullende monitoring mogelijkheden.
1.1.2.de: Ein Fehler bei der Timer-Anzeige wurde behoben. Zusätzliche Überwachungsfunktionen.

1.1.1.en: Ability to delay the execution of flows. Additional tokens for transition cards. Simplified monitoring of timers, stopwatches and transitions.
1.1.1.nl: Mogelijkheid tot vertragen van het uitvoeren van de flows. Extra tokens voor transitie kaartjes. Eenvoudigere monitoring van timers, stopwatches en transities.
1.1.1.de: Möglichkeit, die Ausführung von Flows zu verzögern. Zusätzliche Token für Übergangskarten. Vereinfachte Überwachung von Timern, Stoppuhren und Übergängen.

1.1.0.en: Support for new Homey App Store.
1.1.0.nl: Ondersteuning voor de nieuwe Homey App Store.
1.1.0.de: Unterstützung für den neuen Homey App Store.

1.3.0.en: Added: The Pause/Resume and Stop (and now Start) buttons are pushable and show the status.

1.3.1.en: Correctified: Hints of the Timer and Transition Adjust flowcards.

1.3.2.en: Correctified: Hints of the Timer and Transition Adjust flowcards.

1.3.5.en: Added: Contribution options: Patreon and GithubSponsors (with PayPal already available).

1.4.0.en: Added: Wildcard can now be used in variablenames within Is-Running-conditioncards.

1.4.1.en: Added description: (Chronograph) Delay card works for max. 89 seconds.

1.4.3.en: Added: New flowcards to retrieve the (Elapsed/ToGo) duration of Timers, Stopwatches and Transitions.

1.4.4.en: Improved: Better coding and implementations of SDK3. Also, some triggercards are now also used to generate timers/stopwatches/transitions in the background, for creating a device.

1.4.6.en: Improved: Get duration/elapsed flowcards now have addition text-tags with HH:mm:ss and mm:ss.

1.4.7.en: Improved: Get duration/elapsed flowcards now have more addition text-tags with HH:mm:ss, mm:ss and HH:mm.

1.5.0.en: Improved: Get Duration of [x] flowcards are now Rounded Of to two decimals. This can be adjusted in the App Settings.

1.5.1.en: Improved: Get Duration of [x] flowcards are now Rounded Of to two decimals. This can be adjusted in the App Settings.

1.5.2.en: Bugfixed: Get Duration of Stopwatch gave an error.

1.5.3.en: Improved: Get Duration of [x] flowcards are now Rounded Of to two decimals (or less). This can be adjusted in the App Settings.

1.5.4.en: Improved: App Settings will now also show in-active Chronographs.

1.5.5.en: Bugfixed: Get Duration of Transition also gave an error.

1.6.0.en: Added: Support for other apps to listen to Chronograph changes. See the Device Capabilities app for example. Breaking: The Get All APIs gives JSON respond instead of stringified.

1.6.2.en: Improvement: Better performance when having Chronograph devices. And another bugfix.

1.6.3.en: Bugfixing: Resolving new issue, better error handling and logging.

1.6.5.en: Bugfixing: Resolving new issue, better error handling and logging.

1.6.6.en: Bugfixing: Resolving new issue, better error handling and logging.

1.6.7.en: Bugfixing: Resolving new issue, better error handling and logging, when having lots of chronographs.

1.6.8.en: Bugfixing: Resolving new issue, better error handling and logging, when having lots of chronographs.

1.6.9.en: Bugfixing: Resolving new issue, better error handling and logging, when having lots of chronographs.

1.6.13.en: Bugfixing: Resolving startup issues with older models with many Chronographs.

1.6.14.en: Improved: Small performance when there are no running Chronographs.

1.6.15.en: Bugfixed: Chronographs were not correctly updated for other apps every second, only on start/stop. This is now resolved.

2.0.0.en: New: Chrnographs can now be created and selected within each flowcard. Just type a name, select it and press save. Now you can select it in any flows: No need to remember the names!

2.0.1.en: New: Chrnographs can now be created and selected within each flowcard. Just type a name, select it and press save. Now you can select it in any flows: No need to remember the names!
